title: soryBySelector is not sorting entries on the Front end.

comments.body: I can see requests being done and the index name being changed, so this should work. Is the sort by different in the dashboard if you go to the different indices?

Hmm really @Haroenv?

I did not see this. In the indices I can see the products are not being ordered correctly
Would it be possible to make a minimal reproduction in CodeSandbox and give access to your index for Algolia employees on your dashboard? Will be useful in finding what's going on here.
Would it be possibly because the value we are sorting by is a string not an integer?
Yes, to be able to sort on numbers it definitely needs to be a  number, otherwise the sorting is alphabetical
Ah crap is there a way I can transform that data in the dashboard of Algolia or do I need to reupload all indexes?
Unfortunately there's no way to change that in the dashboard :(

@Haroenv so I've changed the numbers to be integers like so:

![screen shot 2018-06-20 at 16 32 55](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/671281/41668607-9e01779c-74a7-11e8-9196-e761e3741812.png)

I've added the correct attribute to sortBy in the Ranking for the main indice but in the replicas it does not seem to order/reorder by price here

![screen shot 2018-06-20 at 16 34 09](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/671281/41668712-e1c9067a-74a7-11e8-939e-c2ab15090c29.png)

The js code has not changed at all from above and it still doesn't work:

https://viaduct.frb.io/products/bedroom-furniture
So looking at the requests it seems like they are actually completely correct (different results), but it doesn't update visually. What does your `hit` code look like? I guess it's custom?
Closing this for now. If there are any updates, feel free to open a new issue. Thanks for your understanding.
